memories.memory: My current mailing address is 4040 Example Avenue, Apartment 3B, Northfield, and I prefer packages left with the building manager.
I use the fictional contact number 555-0148 and the email address ebrooks@example.org for appointments and volunteer work.
Although I am mostly retired, I still work two days a week as a community-mediation consultant for the Northfield Civic Partnership.
My birthday is October 11, 1957, and I usually take the day off rather than have people make a fuss over it.
My daughter Claire Brooks is listed as my emergency contact, and she lives about forty minutes away in the same county.
My old personnel file at the mediation office is referenced as CASE-0002-EB, which is also the number I use when sorting my archived work papers.
I separated from my husband several years ago but have not legally changed my surname because my professional records and publications are all under Brooks.
